title: DE-4/2023/F2 DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATION FOR JUNIOR MEMBERS OF I.A.S., JUNIOR MEMBERS OF I.P.S. AND JUNIOR MEMBERS OF I.F.S. - DECEMBER, 2022, PAPER - II - FOREST LAW [with books]
